issues.title: Fast Fashion & Textile Waste
issues.hover_description: ESRS E5: 92M tons of textile waste/year. EU Textile Strategy (2030): mandatory recycled content and design-for-durability. EPR for textiles from 2025.

issues.title: Garment Worker Living Wages
issues.hover_description: ESRS S2: 80M garment workers; 98% earn below living wage. EU CSDDD due diligence on Tier-1-3 suppliers. Rana Plaza legacy - structural audit gaps.

issues.title: Food Miles & Logistics Emissions
issues.hover_description: ESRS E1: Last-mile delivery and cold chain represent 40% of FMCG Scope 3. EU Clean Vehicles Directive. Net-zero delivery commitments vs. reality.

issues.title: Retail Worker Zero-Hours & Precarity
issues.hover_description: ESRS S1: 70% of retail workers on variable hours (Eurofound 2023). EU Transparent & Predictable Working Conditions Directive - minimum notice periods.

issues.title: Dark Patterns in E-Commerce
issues.hover_description: ESRS G1: EU Digital Services Act bans manipulative design. 97% of top websites use at least one dark pattern (2022 study). Consumer deception at scale.

issues.title: Product Traceability & Origin Labelling
issues.hover_description: ESRS E4/S2: EU Deforestation Regulation and CSDDD require farm-level traceability for 7 commodities. Digital Product Passport by 2026 for textiles.

issues.title: Promotional Overconsumption
issues.hover_description: ESRS E5: Flash sales and single-day shopping events (Black Friday) drive 40% of annual textile waste. French anti-promotional law on fast fashion as policy signal.

issues.title: Smallholder Supplier Income Vulnerability
issues.hover_description: ESRS S2: FMCG sourcing from 500M smallholder farmers. Climate shocks and price volatility threaten incomes. Buyer power squeeze - 5 buyers control 40% of global grocery.

issues.title: Retail Store Energy Efficiency
issues.hover_description: ESRS E1: Large retail chains operate 100,000s of stores globally. Refrigeration, HVAC, and lighting = 65% of store energy. EU Energy Efficiency Directive Article 8 mandatory audits.

issues.title: Packaging Take-Back & Deposit Return
issues.hover_description: ESRS E5: EU Packaging Regulation (PPWR) 2024 - refillable targets. Deposit Return Schemes mandated in 22+ EU member states. Retailers as collection point.

interdependencies.description: High volume, low price model requires cheap labour
